headline: Pembina Pipeline Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
summary: PBA misses Q2 EPS estimates, but revenues rise 20% year over year as higher volumes and operational strength lift results across its business segments.

headline: PARR Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Refining Margin Strength
summary: Par Pacific's Q2 earnings soared 555.8% and revenues jumped 56.8%, beating estimates as refining margins surged despite lower throughput and softer retail results.
